tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get one Edgepedia article in full, as Markdown with its citations, by the id of a `search` result. Pass `citations: false` for a text about a quarter shorter: [n] markers in place of the inline source links, the reference list kept. Link the article when you use it; show its `credit` line with any t
